_meta.description: Registry of every source used anywhere in this project. A claim in data/ or research/ may only cite a source_id that exists here.

tier_definitions.official_primary: Published by the contest organiser, the listing exchange, or a government/regulatory body. Authoritative for what it states.
tier_definitions.official_secondary: Published by an official body but describing another body's product, or an official press release restating a rulebook.
tier_definitions.non_official: Third-party media, aggregator or blog. NOT used to support any verified claim. Retained only as a lead for further primary-source checking.
